before.name: Eva Harding
before.description: Eva Harding was a Topeka physician and political activist. Federal authorities arrested her on May 31, 1917 in the prosecution over an anticonscription meeting in Topeka. A jury acquitted the four Topeka defendants on all counts on April 12, 1918. The duration of custody and physical release date are not established.
